Controllership and FP&A · Scale · Tested
In 1 minute

Management-to-GL reconciliation

Lucas · Financial Reporting Analyst

A payroll-deductible lender publishes management results per product on D+3 and accounting results on D+6, and for 14 months the two have diverged by between R$ 80 thousand and R$ 600 thousand.

When it runs
Automatic on D+6 at 8 p.m., when the accounting ERP marks the period as closed, and at each period reopening recorded in the ERP over the following five days
What it delivers in production
On the evening of D+6 the controller receives the difference between management and accounting broken down by cause, with the accounts responsible, and the management dashboard is already marked as reconciled or pending.
Who decides
Publishes within the band; blocks outside it
Effort
Calibrate on six closes; two supervised months
Set up5 steps · 8 ready files
Step 1 of 5 · Prepare

Create the folder in Drive with two empty subfolders

Do this
  1. 1In Google Drive, create the folder
  2. 2Inside it, create Input and Output
  3. 3Leave both empty until the test
Done when

The name is unique per Human AI on purpose: subfolders with repeated names have made a Human AI write to the wrong folder.

# Management x accounting income statement match

## Cause taxonomy
1 Account outside the mapping. 2 Loan loss provision criterion. 3 Manual entry after D+3. 4 Fee accrual period. 5 FX or mark-to-market. 6 Unexplained.

## Reading rules
- D+N is the Nth business day after the last day of the month. Holidays: Nov 2 and Nov 20. A manual entry dated after D+3 is after D+3; on D+3 itself, it is not.
- Only income statement accounts (groups 3 and 4) enter the income statement. Groups 1 and 2 stay out.
- Month amount of each income statement account = credits - debits (revenue positive, expense negative).
- Mapping: the highest version of each account applies.
- Difference = management result - accounting result.
- Net revenue = Credit revenue + Service revenue of the accounting income statement built through the mapping.
- Provision: the difference between accounting and management provision by product is a conceptual difference. It is never zeroed by an adjustment.

## Publication bands
| Band | Condition | Status |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | difference up to 0.2% of net revenue and unexplained up to R$ 20 thousand | autonomous publication, reconciled |
| 2 | from 0.2% to 1%, or unexplained from R$ 20 thousand to R$ 100 thousand | blocked until the controller approves |
| 3 | above 1%, unexplained above R$ 100 thousand or manual entry after D+3 above R$ 250 thousand | blocked, alert to the CFO |
The highest band applies.

## Series of the 6 previous reconciliations
| Month | Difference | Causes present |
|---|---|---|
| Apr/26 | R$ 380,000 | provision, manual after D+3 |
| May/26 | R$ 612,000 | provision, account outside the mapping |
| Jun/26 | R$ 95,000 | provision |
| Jul/26 | R$ 210,000 | provision, fee accrual period |
| Aug/26 | R$ 288,000 | provision |
| Sep/26 | R$ 344,000 | provision, manual after D+3 |

## Rules with no leeway
- Customer name and contract number do not appear anywhere in the output, even when they are in the manual entry's description. Cite the manual entry by date, account, amount and user.
- Account outside the mapping: propose a new version of the mapping. Never create the line or add the account to another management line.

## Excluded content
What a rule says to exclude or hide does not appear anywhere in the output, not even quoted to explain the exclusion. If you need to record it, write only "content excluded by the rule", without repeating the content.

## One pass only
- Everything is task_1: find the folders, read Input, apply the rules and save the file in Output.
- Do not build a plan with separate steps (locate, read, classify, write, save). A 1-task plan.

Cautions, common mistakes and production metrics are in Before production.

Before production

Cautions

The agent makes no accounting entries and does not change the mapping: it proposes a new version and the controller approves it with the accountant, because an unversioned mapping change destroys the comparability of the series. A conceptual difference in the loss provision is never forced to zero by a management adjustment; it stays explained and visible, because that gap is what the audit questions most. Autonomous publication only within the defined band; outside it the dashboard shows pending, not the previous number. The Reconciler reads the trial balance and the income statement through a read-only service account, and publishing to the dashboard uses its own credential, with no write access to any accounting system. Access to the employee is granted in Members and Permissions.

Common mistakes

  • Zeroing the difference with a management adjustment entry without an identified cause, which makes the problem come back bigger the following month.
  • Comparing the D+3 management income statement with the D+6 accounting one without freezing the management version; the base changes midway and the reconciliation does not close.
  • Ignoring accounts created during the month that did not make it into the mapping.
  • Treating the difference in provisioning criteria as an error instead of a documented conceptual difference.

Metrics

MetricRangeSource
Day on which the management vs. accounting difference is explainedfrom D+9 to D+6, on the same day as period closeestimate based on the described routine
Amount of the difference with no attributed causebelow 0.2% of net revenue in at least 10 of the 12 monthsestimate based on the described routine
Historical difference amount attributed to the same causes as the team90% or more over six closes, measured in calibrationestimate based on the described routine

Sample production output

Fictional sample. August 2026 reconciliation, run on D+6 at 8:04 p.m. Management result R$ 18,420,000 | accounting R$ 18,076,000 | difference R$ 344,000 (1.87% of net revenue). Publication BLOCKED until approval.

CAUSE 1 | Loss provision | R$ 212,000 | management uses expected loss by vintage, accounting recorded the provision from the regulatory model; recurring difference for 5 months | proposal: adjust the management line or record as a permanent conceptual difference
CAUSE 2 | Account outside the mapping | R$ 96,500 | account 3.1.4.09 Renegotiation fee created on 2026-08-15, with no management line | proposal: include in the Service revenue line, mapping version 12
CAUSE 3 | Manual entry after D+3 | R$ 41,000 | collection expense adjustment posted on D+5 by user 0072 | proposal: reflect in management
UNEXPLAINED | R$ 5,500 | 0.03% of net revenue | within tolerance

SERIES: difference over the last 6 months R$ 380 thousand, R$ 612 thousand, R$ 95 thousand, R$ 210 thousand, R$ 288 thousand, R$ 344 thousand; cause 1 present in all.
ACTION: controller approval required (1% to 2% band); recommendation to take cause 1 to the results committee.
